snapshot.interpretation: Stages 1-4 are closed in sequence. The only active predefined stage is Stage 5 Files / Data / Tools E2E. Do not reopen architecture, provider onboarding, or later stages unless a current P0/P1 proves it necessary.

titan_v1_execution_contract.goal: Finish Titan as an ordinary-user product rather than indefinitely improving architecture.
titan_v1_execution_contract.mandatory_scope_rule: Only P0/P1 findings that block the current V1 user scenario, safety/authority/data integrity, install/run, recovery, pilot, or release may create required work.
titan_v1_execution_contract.finish_condition: P0=0, P1=0, bounded pilot passed, target product dimensions reached, then TITAN V1 — DONE.
